visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy wearing a white baseball jersey and light grey pants walks on a padded brown ledge toward a ball pit filled with white and purple balls. An adult woman with long brown hair, wearing a grey t-shirt, is partially submerged in the balls, reaching out her hand. The background features a large red wall and a detailed mural depicting an outdoor garden scene. (2) The boy reaches down and takes the woman's hand, pulling her toward the ledge. (3) In the next scene, a different woman wearing a blue jersey and ripped jeans is seen sitting on the ledge next to the boy. (4) The scene cuts to a close-up of the boy's face as he walks with determination. (5) The woman in the grey shirt is back in the ball pit, and the boy approaches her again, taking her hand once more. (6) The woman in the blue jersey helps the boy pull the other woman out of the ball pit. (7) The woman in grey sits on the ledge and hugs the boy, then they both use their hands to form half-heart shapes toward each other. (8) The scene shifts to the woman in blue sitting in the ball pit next to a large inflatable unicorn. The boy reaches for her hands to pull her toward the edge. (9) The woman in blue hugs the boy warmly on the ledge. (10) A third woman wearing a white t-shirt and denim shorts is now in the ball pit, and the boy pulls her out by her hand. (11) They sit together on the ledge, the woman hugs the boy, and they perform a heart gesture and a kiss. (12) The video ends with a circular frame showing the woman in the white t-shirt smiling.
